g.text: What changes the load on the wing?
Uniform tailwind at fixed true airspeed
Air-relative flow unchanged → no added load from uniform wind alone
Incidence changes → lift increment → wing bending and torsion
Ribs / skin → spars → wing root → fuselage
Dynamic response also depends on modes, mass, damping and controls.
Conceptual load paths. No actual aircraft geometry or certification loads implied.
